liebermann.notes: Parchment; after London annals to 1274 and among state documents, some for London of the 12th–13th centuries, f. 160 Hn Lond and, after Edward I's London charter, f. 173 ECf retr using ECf to 8,3a. Mem. in the London Guildhall ends at the same point, and Horn is also related to Cc.
